        "func": "//Severity, ReasonCode, Description, TriggerWorkOrder, Unplanned \nvar flowVariableName = msg.payload.deviceName;\nvar line = msg.payload.metadata.line;\nvar plant = msg.payload.metadata.plant;\nvar asset = msg.payload.metadata.name;\nvar SKU = flow.get(flowVariableName + \".SKU\");\nvar shift = global.get(\"shift\");\n\n//check to validate if there was a downtime event captured and build object\nif (flow.get(flowVariableName) !== null) \n{\n//    var date = Date.now();\n    var date = msg.payload.timestamp;\n    var downtimeStart = flow.get(flowVariableName+\".startTime\"); //unix timestamp\n    var downtimeEnd = date; //unix timestamp\n    var totalDowntime = Math.round((downtimeEnd - downtimeStart)/1000); //calculates downtime in seconds\n    var downtimeStartDateTime = new Date(downtimeStart).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '); //Convert to human readable time for DB insert\n    var downtimeEndDateTime = new Date(downtimeEnd).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '); // Convert to human readable time for DB insert\n    //var triggerWorkflow = dtReason.TriggerWorkOrder;\n    var rc_matrix = global.get(\"reasonCode_matrix\");\n    var rc1 = flow.get(flowVariableName+\".reasonCode_L1\");\n    var rc2 = flow.get(flowVariableName+\".reasonCode_L2\");\n    \n    //if flow was started with isRunning = 1, then RC's are zero - this skips those cases\n    if(rc1 <= 0 || rc2 <= 0){\n        return null;\n    }\n    \n    //create object\n    var obj = {};\n        obj.downtimeStart = downtimeStartDateTime;\n        obj.downtimeEnd = downtimeEndDateTime;\n        obj.duration = totalDowntime; //in seconds\n        obj.reasonCode_L1 = rc1;\n        obj.reasonCode_L2 = rc2;\n        obj.reasonCode_L1_text = rc_matrix[rc1-1][rc2-1].ref_reasonCode_L1_desc;\n        obj.reasonCode_L2_text = rc_matrix[rc1-1][rc2-1].ref_reasonCode_L2_desc;\n        obj.comment = \"\";\n        obj.planned = rc_matrix[rc1-1][rc2-1].planned;\n        obj.reasoncode_entered = 1;\n        obj.shift = shift;\n        obj.SKU = SKU;\n        obj.asset = asset;\n        obj.line = line;\n        obj.plant=plant;\n    \n    flow.set(flowVariableName,undefined); // reset the flow.registeID variable\n    //global.set(dtVariableName,null);\n    \n    //msg.payload = Object.assign(msg.payload, obj); //merge incoming msg.payload and the new object (obj) to create 1 msg.payload\n    msg.payload = obj;\n    \n    return msg;\n}",
